verdicts.why: Holds for the 72 h arms only. The same registered rows also hold F336/AP336 (HE) and F168/AP168 (HX), which lose in 18 more window-leads, for example HE|TESS|2026-08-03 at 336 h with d1 2.003 vs 0.632, and HE|TESS|2026-08-31 at 336 h, all four leads.

verdicts.claim: No window has an atmosphere or weather in either arm
verdicts.why: In HX|THEMIS A|2013-02-13 the FFM arm ran ffmLow (all-regimes.mjs:33: drag true, NRLMSISE00) with no weather supplied. The analyst's own table shows drag B 0.0952 solved.

Chords alone are enough for a loss: my post-step chord-truth reruns lose (08-10 FFM 0.659/1.937/3.988/22.07 vs AP 0.636/1.810/3.616/19.10). But all four windows also hold a step in the arc or within 40 min of the cutoff, and on node truth FFM's d3 and d7 rise sharply (08-10 d7 8.59 to 18.05). These are maneuver windows where the chords decide which arm wins, so the 0.741 non-maneuver share is overstated.

verdicts.claim: Scoring (Chandra weekly joins): 6 losses where an arc or bin straddles a join
verdicts.why: The class stands, since FFM is exact within a segment (rows read 0.0000). But the straddle rule does not discriminate: all 7 day-7 bins lie past a join and only 3 lose, and HX|CHANDRA|2018-04-05 at 72 h straddles a join while FFM wins every lead. The losses are AP compensating error against the join offset.

08-17 is supported (post-step arc d1 0.067). 08-31 d1 (0.295 vs 0.268) has its step 6 h after the cutoff, which hits both arms, and the margin sits within the 0.011 to 0.221 km solution-switch floor inside the d1 bin. Nothing tells the steps apart from definitive-OD splices.

verdicts.claim: Settings: the THEMIS A 2013-02-13 regime switch at all-regimes.mjs:128
verdicts.why: The stored rerun has high=false. Forced high, FFM gives 0.033/0.058/0.083/0.190 vs AP 0.147/0.179/0.203/0.937. Which ffmLow knob does the damage was not isolated.

verdicts.claim: Estimator, force and unexplained: zero; no FFM module change indicated
verdicts.why: Every clean test FFM wins: TESS post-step 08-10, 08-17 and (mine) 07-27 at a 12 h arc (0.152/0.253/0.315/1.153 vs 0.190/1.042/2.383/9.522), Chandra after the join, and THEMIS high. The base is small, and for TESS FFM partly agrees with the generating model (fits at the cm level).

verdicts.claim: Chord bias goes into the state, not the SRP coefficient
verdicts.why: Holds for 72 h arcs. On a 9.5 h post-step chord arc (08-10) the solved SRP went to the 0 bound.

verdicts.claim: AP's day-1 lead in the perigee windows is compensating error
verdicts.why: The same data fit the in-arc step taking over once the chord noise is removed. It is not shown to be compensation.

verdicts.claim: Stitching is not the cause (single file within 0.11 km)
verdicts.why: The single-file rows match the registered rows.

verdicts.claim: Integrator, third bodies, relativity and frames are converged and consistent
verdicts.why: Tolerance 1e-10 with 30 s steps gives results identical to the meter; Venus, Jupiter and IERS 2010 relativity change d7 by 4 m.

verdicts.claim: Longer arcs fit and fly worse; conditioning is not the issue
verdicts.why: True for FFM. But AP336 beats F336 on 08-03 (d1 ratio 3.2) and on 08-31 even on node truth: AP degrades more slowly when its arc holds unmodeled steps.
